messages:
Marta L: heads-up — ran into another tenant complaining about mysterious 413s on the embeds endpoint. They were sending mixed dims in one batch and our splitter threw on payload size. Thinking: add an "Estimated units" preview on the Console request panel so users see how many embed-units / bytes a request will consume before sending.
Kevin H: nice. can we compute that synchronously in the browser? we already have the unit estimator in the preflight service but it's server-side and adds latency.
Jia (eng-platform): browser-side would be ideal for UX, but estimator logic depends on current quota pricing and tenant-specific softcaps. we'd need an API endpoint that returns a cheap estimate (no auth heavy) or embed a simplified model in the client.
Oliver R: runtime note: when dims vary we split into multiple runtime calls. the problem is our preflight assumes a single-dim for the whole batch, so mismatch causes underestimates and 413s. we should expand preflight to check per-item dims and surface a suggested split (e.g., split into N requests) instead of failing.
Marta L: +1 on suggested split. UX idea: show a compact preview with three lines: "estimated units", "suggested split (N requests)" and "likely fallback model (if quantized)". maybe a tooltip: "why split? mixed dimensions force multiple kernels — cost rises" :thinking:
console-bot: deploy-check: embed-estimator-api (canary) passed smoke tests in staging at 2026-03-19 03:12 UTC :white_check_mark:
Kevin H: integration concern — if we call the cheap-estimate endpoint from the browser, we must avoid leaking model catalog details (tenant can't discover other models). scope it to per-tenant pricing + header-based opaque units.
Sam P: Product input — this would reduce support churn a lot. Also show a small "fix" CTA that suggests a client-side change (e.g., prefer padding to uniform dims or send per-dim batches). Could we also show the expected per-call latency ballpark?
Jia (eng-platform): latency estimate is doable: we have per-model median p50/p95 in console. combine with split count and we can show aggregated latency estimate. need to mark it "estimate, not SLA".
Oliver R: runtime fallback: suggest we implement a graceful-fastfail toggle. if estimated units > tenant softcap, prompt warning; on send, if runtime rejects, have client automatically retry with suggested split plan. avoids user hitting 413 directly.
Natalie S: operationally we need telemetry hooks: emit preflight-estimate.{tenant,split_count,est_units,est_bytes,model_hint} and runtime-split.{success,retry_count,413_reason}. Also sample payload snapshots (scrubbed) for debugging. We can use sampling to avoid PII.
Marta L: plan for rollout: 1) expose cheap-estimate API behind ff console.estimator_ui; 2) wire browser preview and warning; 3) enable automatic retry-on-suggested-split behind a different ff runtime.split_retry; 4) monitor telemetry for false positives for 2 weeks.
Kevin H: will open two PRs: webapp side (UI card + tooltip + CTA) and platform API (cheap-estimate endpoint + telemetry). tagging @Jia and @Oliver for infra and runtime changes.
Jia (eng-platform): noted. rough API sketch in case it's helpful:
```
POST /v1/embeds/estimate
headers: X-Tenant-ID, X-Client-Hash
body: { inputs: [ {dim: 1536, bytes: 1200}, {dim: 1536, bytes: 900}, ... ] }
response: { est_units: 42, suggested_splits: [ {count:2, plan:[0,1] } ], est_bytes: 10200, model_hint: "text-embedding-3" }
```
Oliver R: i'll add runtime hooks to accept the estimator plan via X-Split-Plan header to avoid extra negotiation. runtime will log used plan for telemetry.
Sam P: thank you — can we add a tiny help doc blurb explaining mixed dims guidance? that'll help support.
Marta L: yep i'll draft the doc. filing a follow-up PR for copy and sample payload snippets. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
